# Quaternius Ultimate Animated Animal Pack

Winter-suitable selections from the Ultimate Animated Animal Pack by
Quaternius: deer, stag, fox, and wolf.

- Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal / public domain dedication
- Original format: embedded glTF
- Runtime format: GLB, repacked without changing geometry, textures, rigs, or
  animation data

The adjacent `LICENSE.txt` contains the license notice distributed with the
pack. These models are loaded through the wilderness animal asset library;
the procedural asset-bank animals remain the safe fallback while a model is
streaming or if loading fails.
